name: WorkBuddy Switch Next icon v2
prompts: Use case: logo-brand. Create one refined desktop software app icon for WorkBuddy Switch Next. Reference image is the ORIGINAL project's green cat and should provide heritage only. This is a fresh design. Art direction: understated, beautifully proportioned, friendly, minimal, a polished indie Mac utility identity. A compact mint-green cat mascot, complete and centered, with softly geometric ears, round head and a small curled tail sweeping under the head to suggest switching. Two tiny dark teal eyes and a tiny calm mouth. The cat's upper right ear has one small clean cobalt-blue geometric accent as the sole blue element, a subtle inherited detail from the original. The head and curled tail form a distinctive single balanced silhouette with plenty of breathing room. Palette: soft jade and mint, dark teal facial details, warm very pale ivory rounded-square tile. Gentle matte clay shading, extremely restrained lighting, no gloss, no extrusion, no heavy shadows. The charm comes from the silhouette and proportions, not ornament. Face should be personable, not generic emoji. Flat frontal view, orthographic, high-quality crisp edges. Transparent alpha outside the rounded ivory app tile. Large simple forms that remain clear at 32 pixels. No arrows, no chevrons, no badges, no letters, no typography, no gradients on background, no neon, no dark blue background, no border, no metallic texture, no 3D presentation mockup, no extra objects. Deliver a single finished square icon only.

Use case: logo-brand. Refine the provided WorkBuddy Switch Next icon without redesigning the mascot. Keep the mint cat's face, curled tail, blue ear detail, matte style and exact composition. Fix ONLY the surrounding background and perimeter: make the entire square canvas a single clean solid warm ivory background, full bleed all the way to all four square edges. No rounded tile boundary, no transparent regions, no black regions, no rough edge, no speckles, no cutout artifacts. The mascot remains centered with its existing generous margins. Crisp polished production icon, no text, no other changes.
integration: Preview candidate; application icons are unchanged.
